sections.label: Account
sections.description: The Klaviyo account this environment's storefront sends newsletter sign-ups and visitor activity to.

fields.name: companyId
fields.label: Public API key (company ID)
fields.description: Klaviyo → Settings → Account → API keys, the six-character public key. Without it, sign-ups and storefront tracking cannot reach Klaviyo.

fields.name: defaultNewsletterListId
fields.label: Newsletter list ID
fields.description: Klaviyo → Lists & segments → your list → Settings, the list ID. Sign-ups without a list of their own go to this list.

fields.name: baseURL
fields.label: API address
fields.description: The Klaviyo API the storefront calls. Leave the default unless Klaviyo gives you another one.

sections.label: Storefront tracking
sections.description: What the storefront sends to Klaviyo from the visitor's browser, once they have accepted marketing cookies.

fields.name: onsiteTracking
fields.label: Track visitors on the storefront
fields.description: Loads Klaviyo's script for visitors who accept marketing cookies, which enables Klaviyo forms, Viewed Product and Added to Cart. Needs a consent app. Newsletter sign-ups work either way.

fields.name: sendStartedCheckout
fields.label: Send Started Checkout from the storefront
fields.description: Turn this on for Shopware. Leave it off for Shopify, where Klaviyo's Shopify integration already sends Checkout Started.
